Learned counsel for the petitioners has filed a memo for withdrawal.

The memo reads as under:
"That the respondent No. 1 Woman Police Ballari, had registered the criminal case in Crime No. 71/2024, against the petitioners herein who are accused No. 2 to 6 therein and accused No. 1, who was the husband of respondent No. 2, on the basis of the complaint lodged by respondent No. 2, for the offences punishable under Section 498(A), 323, 504, 506, read with Section 34 of IPC.

That the respondent No. 1 Police have investigated the matter, filed a charged sheet for the offences punishable und Section 498(A), 323, 504,506, read with Section 34 of IPC, the said charge sheet came to be placed before the learned IV Additional Civil Judge and JMFC Ballari, the learned trial court was pleased to register the case in C.C. No. 1223/2024, against the petitioners herein and also accused No. 1 therein for the above said offences and posted the matter for appearance.
That the present petitioners herein have filed the present criminal petition before this Hon'ble Court challenging the registration of above criminal case against them.
NC: 2026:KHC-D:2898 HC-KAR

That this Hon'ble Court was pleased to grant an interim order as against the petitioners concerned, while staying all other and further proceedings in C.C. No. 1223/2024, pending on the file of the IV Additional Civil Judge and JMFC Ballari.
That it is most respectfully submited that the respondent No. 2 and accused No. 1 therein have settled their disputes and rejoined together, leading their marital life with peacefully.
